SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. S. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date December 2, 1935.
Subject Two Japanese deported from Shanghai.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by [签名]
With reference to the instructions of D. C. (Special
Branch) on the attached translation from the Shanghai Nichi-
Nichi, I have to state that the two Japanese named Shichiro
Watanabe, aged 28, and Nuikichi Oshima, aged 26, were arrested
together with the other three Japanese namely; Kakichi Tanaka,
Yoshio Nakagawa and Genjiro Sato, by a party of police despatched
from Hongkew Station at 9 p.m. on October 27, 1935, in the
vicinity of Haining Road Bridge, where they were fighting with
a number of Chinese, nine of whom they injured. The five
Japanese were subsequently handed over to the local Japanese
Consular Police. Genjiro Sato and Kankichi Tanaka were
released by the Consular Police on the following day, as they were
found to be innocent. Shichiro Watanabe and Nuikichi Oshima
were deported to Japan on the s.s. "Ikoma Maru" on November 27,
1935, and Yoshio Nakagawa is still detained at the Japanese
Consulate pending enquiries. These five Japanese came to
Shanghai from Japan in search of employment in September and
October, 1935, but owing to their failure to get jobs they
were staying at the "Ichijuen", a free lodging house, at Lane
97, House 83, Haining Road until their arrest on October 27,
1935.
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 2 DEC 1935 CRIME BRANCH）
（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE 4 DEC. 1935 SHANGHAI）
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.
D.C. (Crime)
Information and kindly pass to
A/Commissioner of Police.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别支部虹口分站，
报告
日期：1935年12月2日。
事由：两名日本人被驱逐出上海。
制作人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：[签名]
关于随附《上海日日新闻》译文中特别支部副总监（D. C. (Special Branch)）的指示，本人谨陈述如下：1935年10月27日晚9时，由虹口巡捕房派出的一队警员在海宁路桥附近逮捕了两名日本人，即28岁的渡边七郎（Shichiro Watanabe）和26岁的大岛努伊吉（Nuikichi Oshima），当时他们正与数名中国人斗殴，致使九名中国人受伤。另有三名日本人，即田中角吉（Kakichi Tanaka）、中川芳雄（Yoshio Nakagawa）和佐藤源次郎（Genjiro Sato）也一同被捕。随后，这五名日本人均被移交给当地日本领事馆警察。佐藤源次郎和田中角吉因经查无罪，于次日被领事馆警察释放。渡边七郎和大岛努伊吉于1935年11月27日由“生驹丸”号轮船（s.s. "Ikoma Maru"）遣返回日本，中川芳雄目前仍被拘留在日本领事馆以待调查。这五名日本人于1935年9月和10月间从日本来到上海寻找工作，但因未能找到工作，一直借住在海宁路97弄83号的免费宿所“一元园”（Ichijuen），直至1935年10月27日被捕。
（印：副总监 1935年12月2日 刑事科）

November 27, 1935. Morning Translation.

NICHI-NICHI(24-II-35)

TWO JAPANESE SUBJECTS EXPELLED FROM CHINA

Two Japanese named S. Watanabe,
age 28, and K. Oshima, age 26, were ordered to be
expelled from China as undesirable characters by the
Japanese Consular Police yesterday. They will not
be permitted to return to China for one year after their
deportation.

S2. Please let me know if any information
is available about the antecedents of
S. Watanabe and K. Oshima. MG 27 NOV. 1935

O.S. Kamachi
DSR 27/11

两名日本臣民被驱逐出中国

两名日本人，即28岁的S. Watanabe和26岁的K. Oshima，昨日被日本领事馆警察以不受欢迎人物为由下令驱逐出中国。他们在被驱逐后一年内不得返回中国。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. I. REGISTRY
Fracas between Japanese and Chinese in Hongkew District
S. B. D. 7848
31 / 10 35

At about 8.10 p.m. October 27, two drunken and
unemployed Japanese, one named N. Oshima, 26, and the other
Y. Nakagawa, became involved in a fight with some Chinese
at the corner of Haining Road and Fearon Road. They later
claimed to have lost their jackets, a pair of shoes and a
hat, but this has not been established by the Police investi-
gation.

The two Japanese returned to their hotel, a Japanese
hostel at Lane 97, House No.83 Haining Road, and after relating
what had happened to several other lodgers, they procured a
knife each and went back to the scene of the trouble in company
with three other Japanese lodgers named K. Tanaka, I. Watanabe
and S. Sano.

Upon reaching the place, the Japanese assert that
they were again surrounded by Chinese and further fighting
took place in which Nakagawa used his knife and Oshima wielded
an iron bar in addition to a knife. The other three Japanese
endeavoured to put a stop to the trouble.

With the arrival of the Police, order was quickly
restored. Oshima and Nakagawa, who had received minor injuries,
were treated at the Foo Ming Hospital. Nakagawa alleges that
he had been struck with a police baton after his arrest.

Five Chinese who received slight injuries were given
attention at St. Luke's Hospital. When questioned, none of them
could advance a reason for the attack. As far as could be
ascertained, the Japanese had received no provocation whatever.

All the five Japanese have been handed over to the
Japanese Consular Authorities. Oshima and Nakagawa will be
charged with assault.

No Br. Report, File

情报登记处
虹口区日华冲突
特别支部档案号 7848
1935年10月31日

10月27日晚8时10分左右，两名醉酒且无业的日本人，一名为26岁的N. Oshima，另一名为Y. Nakagawa，在海宁路与斐伦路（Fearon Road）转角处与一些中国人发生斗殴。他们后来声称丢失了夹克、一双鞋和一顶帽子，但警方调查并未证实此事。

这两名日本人回到他们的住所，即海宁路97弄83号的一家日式旅馆，在向其他几名住客讲述事发经过后，他们每人取了一把刀，并与另外三名同为住客的日本人，即K. Tanaka、I. Watanabe和S. Sano，一同返回事发现场。

到达现场后，日本人声称他们再次被中国人包围，并发生了进一步的斗殴，期间中川（Nakagawa）使用了刀具，大岛（Oshima）除刀具外还挥舞了一根铁棒。另外三名日本人试图制止骚乱。

随着警方的到来，秩序迅速恢复。受轻伤的大岛和中川在福明医院（Foo Ming Hospital）接受了治疗。中川声称他在被捕后遭到了警棍殴打。

五名受轻伤的中国人被送往圣路加医院（St. Luke's Hospital）接受治疗。在接受询问时，他们均无法说明发动攻击的原因。据查，日本人未受到任何挑衅。

所有五名日本人均已移交给日本领事当局。大岛和中川将被指控犯有袭击罪。

无英方报告，档案

THE CHINA PRESS, MONDAY, OCTOBER 28, 1935

7 Chinese Hurt In
Fight With Japanese

Seven Chinese were seriously in-
jured while several others received
slight bruises when they were
caught and attacked by four al-
legedly drunken Japanese at
Szekatzchiao, Haining Road, Hong-
kew District, at 9.50 p.m. yesterday.
One of the Japanese was holding
a sword, another a stick, while the
two others were bare-handed. As
they walked on in zig-zagged steps
the two, sword and stick in hand,
struck whoever that came their way
while the two others challenged
people with their fists.
As they enjoyed the game of
beating, several policemen came
and arrested the two Japanese with
sword and stick, while the two
others ran away. The seven in-
jured Chinese were subsequently
sent to hospital.

《字林西报》，1935年10月28日，星期一

七名中国人在
与日本人的斗殴中受伤

昨晚9时50分，在虹口区海宁路四卡子桥（Szekatzchiao），四名据称醉酒的日本人抓住并袭击了一些中国人，导致七名中国人重伤，另有数人受轻微挫伤。其中一名日本人手持军刀，另一名手持棍棒，而另外两人则赤手空拳。他们步履蹒跚地前行，手持军刀和棍棒的两人见人就打，而另外两人则挥拳挑衅路人。
正当他们享受殴打他人的乐趣时，几名警察赶到，逮捕了手持军刀和棍棒的两名日本人，而另外两人则逃跑了。七名受伤的中国人随后被送往医院。
